title: R7-50 official-test evaluation, phase L (LLaVA-1.5-7B, D1-20 selectors)
latency_label: latency measured on the pre-fixed profiling workload: the frozen D1-30 timing results of the mapped validation benchmark (gqa_dev for GQA testdev-balanced, chartqa_val for ChartQA test; NVIDIA H100 NVL on nodesumo01, 8 forced decode steps, B* = 4 primary).  Not re-measured on test and not the test sets' actual mean end-to-end latency (it depends on input shapes, generation lengths and batch composition)
exposure_statement: Relative to this project: the test splits were never used for selector training, hyperparameters or any selection; every row, checkpoint, operating point and statistic was fixed before the read.

Relative to the hosts' public training data: LLaVA-1.5's instruction mix (llava_v1_5_mix665k.json) includes GQA train-balanced, Visual Genome, COCO and TextCaps.  GQA's test splits extend Visual Genome with new images whose scene graphs are hidden (Hudson & Manning 2019), so test-dev images need not be Visual Genome images: the build counts the test-dev image ids by prefix ('n'-prefixed vs numeric Visual Genome ids) and the test-dev images and (image, question) pairs present in the mix (sources.<bench>.exposure_check; the measured sentence is exposure_statement_measured).  ChartQA is not part of LLaVA-1.5's published instruction mix.
Undisclosed upstream pre-training exposure (CLIP ViT-L/14-336, Vicuna) is not guaranteed either way.
exposure_statement_measured: GQA test-dev: 398 of 398 images have 'n'-prefixed ids (not Visual Genome ids) and 0 numeric Visual Genome ids; 0 appear in LLaVA-1.5's instruction mix by image id (0 under gqa/, 0 under vg/); 0 of 12578 (image, normalised question) pairs appear among its GQA turns.
ChartQA test: 0 entries of LLaVA-1.5's instruction mix have chart image paths.
